cases.title: A version moves from UPLOADED to ACTIVE
cases.when: A package is uploaded, verified, reviewed, enabled and rolled out
then: States UPLOADED, VERIFIED, IN_REVIEW, APPROVED, ROLLING_OUT, ACTIVE, each audited

cases.title: Verification or review can reject
cases.when: A package fails verification, another fails review
then: REJECTED from VERIFIED and from IN_REVIEW

cases.title: Transitions outside the diagram are refused
cases.when: An API call moves UPLOADED to ACTIVE

cases.title: A host failing self-tests does not serve the version
cases.when: One host fails self-tests during pre-stage
then: That host never serves the version

cases.title: A failing health gate pauses and rolls back
cases.when: The new version's OUTCOME_UNKNOWN rate exceeds the baseline during soak
then: Automatic pause, then ROLLED_BACK when configured

cases.title: Pause, resume, promote and rollback work
cases.when: An admin pauses, resumes, promotes, then rolls back
then: Each transition happens and bumps the catalog revision where exposure changes

cases.title: Rollback never deletes the new version
then: Only as a new version, or the same digest after review

cases.title: At most two versions are routable
cases.when: A third version starts rolling out
then: Refused unless policy raises the limit to three

cases.title: Retirement waits for references and retention
cases.when: An old version drains with one task still running
then: Stays DRAINING until no task or invocation references the digest and retention passes

cases.title: In-flight work keeps its config revision
cases.when: A global value changes while a task runs
then: The task keeps the admitted revision; new work uses the new one

cases.title: Auto-update stops at review on a non-empty delta
cases.when: A PATCH channel receives a delta-free update and one with a security delta
then: The first rolls out; the second stops at IN_REVIEW
